Biblical usage includes both the basic quality of being a knave or deceiver and active plotting against others. The contexts involve treacherous conspiracy (Joseph's brothers), enemy deception (Midianites), and faithless worship (offering blemished sacrifices). The word emphasizes not mere lying but calculated, cunning schemes to achieve selfish or harmful ends."
